question: If the value of the refractive index increases then:

options.text: there is no deviation in direction of light
deviation in direction of light increases

solution:
The correct answer is __**deviation in direction of light increases**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When the refractive index increases, the deviation in the direction of light also increases.
